$comment: The shared contract for the run card's Now projection (#722).
hand-written by necessity — there is no shared runtime between the daemon
and the browser — so this table is the only thing that makes 'deliberately
mirrored by hand' a checkable claim rather than a comment.
Adding a case here obliges BOTH implementations. That is the point: a case
that only one side can pass is a divergence caught at the gate instead of
`body` and `expected` are part lists. A string part is literal; a
[unit, count] part repeats `unit` `count` times, so an over-cap fixture
stays readable instead of shipping 5,000 literal characters.
`limit` is optional; absent means unbounded (the wake-injection callers).
